about.body: The N54 is BMW's twin-turbocharged 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine, in production from 2006 to 2016. In BMW-badged applications, the N54 is primarily associated with the E89-generation Z4 sDrive35i (2009–2016) — the first BMW Z4 to use a turbocharged engine, replacing the naturally aspirated N52 that had been used in earlier E89 models. Beyond BMW itself, the same N54 engine family was also used by Alpine in the A110 and by Morgan in the Plus 6.

byModel.body: Across the Z4, the N54 powered the sDrive35i (E89, 2009–2016) — the range-topping petrol variant of the second-generation Z4 roadster. Production of the E89 Z4 ended in 2016, so all N54 applications in BMW badging are now out of production.

compatibility.body: Because the N54 appears in only one BMW application, compatibility is simpler than for engines spanning multiple model lines — the E89 Z4 sDrive35i is the only BMW-badged application we work on. If you're looking for an N54 for a BMW, we confirm your exact Z4 configuration by registration before quoting or supplying anything.
